businesses.title: Businesses
businesses.description: The businesses you resell. Their owners sign in at your dashboard address.
businesses.loadFailed: We couldn't load your businesses. Refresh to try again.

empty.title: No businesses yet
empty.description: Create a business and invite its owner.
empty.memberDescription: Your partner's owners and admins create businesses here.

create.title: Create a business
create.description: Its owner gets an email from {{partnerName}} with a link to sign in.

access.full: Its team runs the receptionist: knowledge, hours, services and team members. They don't see billing, API keys or MCP.
access.activity: Its team sees calls, chats, appointments, contacts and messages. You set up the receptionist.

errors.invalidName: Enter the business's name, up to 120 characters.
errors.invalidEmail: Enter one valid email address for the owner.
errors.domainRequired: You need a dashboard address before you can create a business. Ask {{appName}} to set one up.
errors.rateLimited: You created too many businesses. Try again in an hour.
errors.failed: We couldn't create the business. Try again.

team.title: Team
team.description: People who can use this console.
team.loadFailed: We couldn't load the team. Refresh to try again.

invite.title: Invite someone to your team
invite.description: They get an email with a link to join {{partnerName}}.

roles.owner: Runs everything, including billing, the Stripe connection and deleting the partner.
roles.admin: Manages businesses, packages, branding, domains, keys and the team.

errors.failed: We couldn't send the invitation. Try again.
errors.rateLimited: You sent too many invitations. Try again in an hour.

errors.changeFailed: We couldn't change that role. Try again.

errors.revokeFailed: We couldn't cancel that invitation. Try again.
errors.finalOwner: Your partner needs at least one owner.

branding.title: Branding & domain
branding.description: What your businesses see on your dashboard address, in the browser tab and in your emails.
branding.loadFailed: We couldn't load your brand. Refresh to try again.
branding.membersCantEdit: Only owners and admins can change the brand.

domain.title: Dashboard address
domain.none: You don't have an address of your own yet. Ask {{appName}} to set one up.

branding.nameHelp: Your businesses see it in the browser tab, above sign-in and as the sender of your emails.
branding.logoHelp: Shown above sign-in and in your emails. PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG, up to 256 KB.
branding.faviconHelp: The icon in the browser tab. Without one, the tab shows your logo.

links.title: Links
links.description: Your sign-in page and dashboard link to these. Leave a field empty to hide its link.
links.supportEmailHelp: Replies to your emails go here. Without a support page, your support link opens this address.

errors.failed: We couldn't save your brand. Try again.
errors.name: Enter a name of up to 80 characters.
errors.color: Enter the color as a hex code, such as #0f766e.
errors.link: Enter each link as a full web address that starts with https://.
errors.imageType: Upload a PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG image.
errors.imageSize: Upload an image of 256 KB or smaller.
errors.forbidden: Only owners and admins can change the brand.

errors.rateLimited: You signed up too many partners today. Try again tomorrow.
errors.failed: We couldn't create the partner account. Try again.
